answer: Like mycelium binding forest soil, our decentralized network binds trust through transitive staking bonds. Each peer weaves a thread of staked capital into the consensus fabric, dying its reputation with indelible proof-of-interaction pigment. An adversary attempting a Sybil attack cannot fake this organic density; forging thousands of identities scales the validation deposit at a superlinear cost ($O(N^2)$), turning every malicious whisper into an economically suicidal echo.
